name: Rotodjur

facts.text: Rotodjur (script Rotoddjur) is a level-71 named with 10,000 health that raises four or five Rotoddjur's Servants and poisons.
A June 2003 Allakhazam comment describes it as a big mushroom whose 4-5 smaller mushrooms killed a level 50 warrior in about eight seconds.
Swedish rot means root or rot, and djur animal or beast (to verify).

story: In the far east halls of Trollheim, where no troll has lived since the Fathers left, the floor grows. Rotodjur is the oldest thing growing there, a mushroom the size of a house with a beast's appetite, rooted in whatever the Fathers left behind when they went down. When something warm comes close it buds, and the buds walk, and they are hungry too. The morvalt will not go into the east halls at all. They say the Fathers left something there on purpose, to keep the halls empty, and that it has done its work too well.
legend: Clear the back of the room first so you don't add Rotodjur by accident. When it spawns its servants, kill them fast or kite them; they hit far harder than they look. One high-level group is not enough, the old comments say.
